facts.fact: The digital ministry's guide sets out Law No. 2018-20 of 17 April 2018 on startups and Government Decree No. 2018-840 of 11 October 2018 on the Startup label, with corporate tax exemption, a startup grant, a guarantee fund for startups and tax deductions for startup investors.
